name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted AI agent runtime with a web dashboard for chat, memory, cron jobs, tools and multi-channel messaging, using your own LLM provider keys.

alerts.message: Pair the dashboard right after deployment: copy the one-time code from the PAIRING REQUIRED box in the container logs and enter it on the dashboard. The code expires after 10 minutes; restart the app to print a new one while no device is paired. To pair again later, run `zeroclaw gateway get-paircode --new` in the container.
An API key for an LLM provider (OpenRouter, Anthropic, OpenAI or another supported one) must be added through the dashboard Quickstart before the agent can reply.
